scenario: A customer asks to reschedule an existing appointment.
expected_outcome: The agent must verify the customer, check actual availability, obtain confirmation from the customer, call update_appointment, and accurately confirm the final date and time.

requirements: Verify the customer before accessing the appointment.
Do not state availability unless supported by the availability tool result.
Do not claim that the appointment was changed unless update_appointment succeeded.
Clearly confirm the final appointment date and time.

turns.content: I need to move my appointment to Monday morning.
I can help. Please confirm the last four digits of the phone number on your account.
Thank you. I’ll locate your appointment and check Monday morning availability.
Monday at 10:00 AM or 11:30 AM is available. Which time would you prefer?
I’ll move it to Monday at 10:00 AM.
Your appointment is confirmed for Monday, August 3 at 10:00 AM. Your confirmation number is CNF-83914.
